fresh_source_evidence.fact: Current INSPIRE Index Polygons release is published 5 July 2026 and remains available until the next monthly update.
New INSPIRE Index Polygon files are published on the first Sunday of each month.
INSPIRE polygons are downloadable by local authority as GML under OGL conditions.
INSPIRE polygons represent indicative position and extent rather than definitive registered-title boundaries.
LIDAR Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England at 1m resolution and removes surface objects to model bare-earth terrain.
Where repeat surveys exist the newest best-resolution data is used; resampling uses bilinear interpolation.
The DTM 1m service uses EPSG:27700 and the published vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE.
The persistent LIDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS endpoint supports WCS 2.0.1.
LiDAR Composite download ZIPs include a GeoPackage spatial metadata index describing raster location and temporal extent.
OS Terrain 50 is updated annually in July and is supplied as 10km-by-10km tiles.
OS Terrain 50 grid data uses 50m spacing with 200 by 200 pixels per 10km tile and heights to the nearest 0.1m.
OS Terrain 50 grid supply includes ASC, GML, PRJ and per-tile Metadata_<tile>.xml companion files.
OS Terrain 50 per-tile XML metadata provides tile reference and terrain metadata, including flying-date information.
OS Terrain 50 grid height points are verified to 4m RMSE.
The current OS Terrain 50 known-data-issues page reports no live known data issues.
Batch132 now requires an exact local SHA256/Git-blob publish manifest and a freshly fetched origin remote-tracking ref before accepting any remote readback.
